decision.title: Hitstory
tracklist: (Now & Then There's) A Fool Such as I
A Little Less Conversation (JXL Radio Edit Remix)
I Forgot to Remember to Forget
I Want You, I Need You, I Love You
Wear My Ring Around Your Neck
You Don't Have to Say You Love Me
Got a Lot O' Livin' to Do
I'm Left, You're Right, She's Gone
The Girl of My Best Friend

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (91 tracks) per http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hitstory, https://www.discogs.com/release/2588432-Elvis-Presley-Hitstory. 2005 RCA 3-CD set (82876712472): Disc 1 = ELV1S 30 #1 Hits + 'Way Down' + 'A Little Less Conversation (JXL Radio Edit Remix)' (31 tracks); Disc 2 = 2nd to None (30 tracks, incl. previously unreleased 'I'm a Roustabout' and 'Rubberneckin'' Oakenfold remix); Disc 3 = 'The Story Continues' (30 tracks). 91 tracks total, flattened in order above. Tracklist shown is the US edition, cross-verified on Wikipedia, Discogs and Last.fm. The European edition's Disc 3 differs (opens with 'I Beg of You', 'My Wish Came True', 'Fame and Fortune', 'I Gotta Know', 'Flaming Star'...); 'My Way' there is the alternative live 1977 version.
